links.outcome: Whether automatic field-level metrics predict expert-rated clinical quality of LLM infertility decision support
links.effect: GRPO had highest automatic performance (e.g., infertility type accuracy 92.57%), yet blinded experts rated SFT directionally higher on reasoning and feasibility; SFT chosen best in 51.2% vs GRPO 26.2%.
links.quote: Outcome-based metrics alone are insufficient proxies for clinical utility in ART decision support.

links.outcome: Hallucination rate in LLM outputs on expert review of 100 paired cases
links.effect: Hallucination rates were 15% (GRPO) and 18.5% (SFT); expert review found clinically unsupported content despite higher automatic performance.
links.quote: Hallucination rates were 15% (GRPO) and 18.5% (SFT), indicating that higher automatic performance did not eliminate clinically unsupported content and that neither model is ready for clinical deployment.

unlisted_practices: Comparing posttraining alignment strategies (SFT, DPO, GRPO, ICL) for medical LLMs on both automatic and expert-rated outcomes

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs fine-tuned with different alignment methods (SFT, DPO, GRPO, ICL) on clinical decision-making tasks using retrospective EHR data and expert clinician evaluation. It tests model training/alignment paradigms rather than an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
